title: Scammers "Microsoft" from start to finish (Microsoft Tech Support)
description: Apparently it happens more and more often that people in the Netherlands are also approached by telephone by so -called Microsoft employees, with the announcement the computer is infected with viruses. By bluffing and using technical terms, they try to let people pay wrong money for unnecessary "repairs" to computers.  After I have been called by scammers for the second time, I used my daughter's camera setup to record this.  Note: For this recording I used a virtual computer. Never let an unknown check from your computer!  Once they have control and you are not willing to pay, they will try to lock your computer so that it no longer starts.   Unfortunately, the screen capture is of low quality, making it difficult to read the text. I hope that this helps to make these shameless scammers a bit more difficult.
